mapper.select: SELECT ID, `LANGUAGE`, LABEL, DETAIL FROM OP_COMMON_CODE WHERE ID = #{id, javaType=string, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND `LANGUAGE` = #{language, javaType=string, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY ORDERING ASC
SELECT `LANGUAGE`, CODE_TYPE, ID, LABEL, DETAIL FROM OP_COMMON_CODE WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY `LANGUAGE`, CODE_TYPE, ORDERING
mapper.insert:
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(ORDERING), 0) + 1 FROM OP_COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = #{codeType} AND `LANGUAGE` = #{language}
INSERT INTO OP_COMMON_CODE (CODE_TYPE, `LANGUAGE`, ID, LABEL, DETAIL, ORDERING, USE_YN) VALUES (#{codeType}, #{language}, #{id}, #{label}, #{detail}, #{ordering}, #{useFlag})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM OP_COMMON_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = #{codeType} AND `LANGUAGE` = #{language} AND ID = #{id}
